internalEvidence: Starting instructions were checked on rendered publisher pages, including relevant mode context. Publisher source context: https://cdn.svc.asmodee.net/production-asmodeeca/uploads/2023/07/t2re15-rules-EN.pdf. Finding: Start with the player who has visited the greatest number of European countries during their lifetime, then continue clockwise. Local source SHA-256: 9dc1f4210477d61dcd9b1baed990f4080fe372b657f6531f6e57c98197487fae. Rendered cover, printed/PDF page 4 and final page 8 were inspected. Anniversary symbols on the cards and the copyright ending in 2021 identify this edition. The separate current publisher file's first-player instruction was inspected and differs; neither answer is generalized across editions. Editorial review 2026-09-23: Rechecked the cited starting instruction, edition, official alternative and variant context against publisher PDF pages. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22.
uncertainty: No starting tie-break is stated alongside this instruction.
The answer applies to the identified publisher file; other editions may differ.
